biocs.name: Uncommon Signed Process Execution by Scheduled Task
biocs.description: Detection of signed binary execution triggered by a scheduled task
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\schtasks.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Execution with Signed Binary
abiocs.description: Detection of signed binary execution initiated by a scheduled task, flagged as anomalous behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\schtasks.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678'
